verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing platform, so this story applies to it. The evidence shows virtual card issuance and merchant/category/ID blocking, but nothing about single-use cards, locking a card to one merchant, or exact-amount limits. A merchant blocklist is an adjacent control, not merchant-locking, and self-authorization (docs-18) is only a building block a developer could use to construct this, so neither earns credit.
